title.zh: CoinEx to Close Exchange on Ninth Anniversary
title.en: CoinEx to Close Exchange on Ninth Anniversary

current_state.zh: CoinEx is closing its exchange on its ninth anniversary, ending withdrawals on Dec. 22, while on-chain data attributes $422.7 million across 3.2 million addresses to the platform and its reserve page shows no current audit rows.
current_state.en: CoinEx is closing its exchange on its ninth anniversary, ending withdrawals on Dec. 22, while on-chain data attributes $422.7 million across 3.2 million addresses to the platform and its reserve page shows no current audit rows.
